Sample.evidence_source: Most of the men explicitly allocated responsibility for their suicidality.

Population.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/7] For one of them, it was the first time he had attempted suicide and he seemed ambivalent. For the other, it was his third suicide attempt and he called because he, in his own words, lost the courage after having swallowed sleeping pills.

Type.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/11] "I have sleeping problems during night or rather always. Thus, I got sleeping pills from my doctor … and …. I took all of them at once. Ninety pills. And that was after a large consumption of alcohol, so … I don't think I knew that I took them" (middle-aged man).
